images.title: Hectares to acres
images.purpose: Shows the conversion 1 hectare = 2.471 acres used as a proportion to turn 2 hectares into 4.942 acres.
images.composition: A double number line across the middle of the frame. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Top line in teal (#0072B2) with the word 'hectares' at its right end; bottom line in amber (#E69F00) with the word 'acres' at its right end; both start at a shared left tick labelled '0'. Top ticks: '1' at the halfway point and '2' at the full length. Bottom ticks: '2.471' directly below 1 and '4.942' directly below 2. A short reddish purple (#CC79A7) arrow along the bottom from 2.471 to 4.942 labelled '× 2'. Exactly 2 lines, 5 ticks.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: A unit conversion is a proportion: multiply by the number of new units in one old unit.
images.description: Shows the conversion 1 hectare = 2.471 acres used as a proportion to turn 2 hectares into 4.942 acres.

image_decisions.why: Lining hectares up against acres shows that converting is the same Rule of Three.
